First governed program hulls field trials: program logistics monitoring published openly, rationing tech oversight in place.

definition: Estimates Drought Shield Programs readiness from component maturity.

title: Drought Shield Programs Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Drought Shield Programs operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Drought Shield Programs installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 1672 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where water banks monitoring, program logistics redundancy, or rationing tech maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Drought Shield Programs Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Drought Shield Programs: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Drought Shield Programs — programs shielding regions from drought.

Phase 1 — Prove (water banks): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (program logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (rationing tech): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (crop switching): program hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and arid regions-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
